fee_regulatory_authority_status.body: Fee Regulating Authority (FRA), Government of Maharashtra
fee_regulatory_authority_status.note: Fees for SBJITMR are officially regulated and approved on an annual basis by the Fee Regulating Authority (FRA) Maharashtra in accordance with the Maharashtra Unaided Private Professional Educational Institutions Act.
